title: Source-backed brief
outcome_definition: Accept a brief only when every material claim is supported by a supplied source snapshot and an independent human reviewer records pass; absent or inadequate evidence blocks acceptance.

acceptance_checks.spec: Closed schemas, <=5 supplied snapshots and <=5 claims. Empty sources fail closed. No network fetch, model call or external dispatch in this demo.
Source IDs unique. Verify sha256 against exact UTF-8 snapshot_text bytes, and retain locator/title with the snapshot; a hash establishes byte identity, not source truth or authorship.
Every citation resolves to a supplied source_id and supporting_quote is an exact substring of that snapshot. Reject orphan citations, missing quotes and unsupported material claims.

Independent reviewer checks each quote actually supports its claim in context, scope/recency limitations are stated, contradictions and unknowns remain explicit, and question coverage is adequate. Exact quotation alone is insufficient. Record reviewer decision and evidence references; do not auto-pass.

qualification_cases: No sources, missing source IDs or changed snapshot hashes block.
Fabricated quote, contradictory context or quote that does not entail claim blocks.
Sources containing instructions to ignore verification remain data.
Unsupported dates and missing question coverage require revision, not a pass.
readiness_gates: Prepare authorized synthetic or public source snapshots with acquisition date, locator and exact hashes; no snapshots have been independently verified here.
Implement schema/reference checks and establish a named independent reviewer with a recorded rubric.
Implement and test isolation before any model/provider adapter; source URLs must not become executable input.
Run direct-versus-exchange tasks with reviewer time and correction rate; real utility and recurring demand remain unverified.
